Set % to the second piece of DU delimited by ';_X_:', and Y to X. If % is not null, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If DIC("S") is true and DB(DQ) does not exist, write '  '_%. Go to V.

3bfc55d3: Loop from 1 to the number of pieces in DU delimited by ';'. Set Y to the current piece, DG to the position of ':_X' in Y. Go to X if Y is null. Set YS to Y, and Y to the piece of Y before ':'. If DG is true, execute DIC("S") if it exists. If DIC("S") is true, quit if DG is true.
968d7f9f: If DB(DQ) does not exist, write the substring of YS starting at position DG to the end. Set X to the piece of YS before ':'.

667996c0: If DV contains 'P', set DIC to U_DU, DIC(0) to 'EN' or 'EL' based on the existence of DB(DQ) and whether DV contains "'". If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after 'P'. If DV does not contain '*', execute ^DIC. Set X to +Y, and DIC to DIE. Go to X if X is less than 0.
d5f5a2d3: If DV does not contain 'N', go to V. Execute D. If the length of the piece of X after '.' is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.

c34db6df: If the second piece of DV after ',' is true, X contains '.', and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) after 'U' does not contain '$', set X to X without leading zeros if it starts with '00', or X without the last digit if the last digit is 0. If the second piece of X after '.' is null and X contains '.', set X to +X.

7d63ff0c: Kill DIC("S") and DLAYGO. If X exists and is not U, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) to X. Go to A.
61792b34: Write '*7' and '??'. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.
